done_when: On Windows, Mac and Linux the canvas renderer passes a page that fits 375 pixels and still refuses a page that scrolls sideways at that width
why: On Windows the canvas renderer refuses every page with 'The page scrolls sideways at 375 pixels, or Chrome could not measure it', even a page with no sideways scroll (tests/test_uistandards_canvas.py::test_2 fails on windows-latest in forge-next.yml run 42302807199). Likely cause: headless Chrome on Windows does not give a 375-pixel-wide window, so innerWidth is not 375 and the check in src/forge/templates/design/support.js treats that as a failure.
